title.narrative: Supporting the Shift to Electric Mobility in Zimbabwe

description.narrative: Accelerating the introduction of electric mobility in Zimbabwe with a focus on reducing GHG emissions, improving air quality and the environmentally sound management of EV waste.
Note: Disbursement data provided is cumulative and covers disbursement made by the project Agency.

The adoption of EVs in Zimbabwe offers significant socio-economic benefits. It will contribute to reducing air pollution, leading to improved public health by decreasing respiratory/other diseases associated with emissions from ICE vehicles. This reduction in healthcare costs can relieve financial pressure on both individuals and the national health system. Economically, the shift to EVs can decrease the country's reliance on imported fossil fuels, improving energy security and reducing expenditure on fuel imports. The growth of the EV sector can create new job opportunities in manufacturing, maintenance, and the development of charging infrastructure, promoting local skill development and economic growth. Furthermore, the promotion of EVs aligns with global sustainability goals, potentially attracting international investment and support for green initiatives.
